description: Client-side script for the 'Shipment' doctype in ERPNext, handling form interactions, queries, validations, and related functionalities.

methods.name: address_query
methods.description: Returns a query configuration for address lookup based on link doctype and name.

methods.name: contact_query
methods.description: Returns a query configuration for contact lookup based on link doctype and name.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Initializes form queries for addresses, contacts, and delivery notes upon form load.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Hides pickup and delivery address/contact sections on form refresh.

methods.name: before_save
methods.description: Sets delivery and pickup addresses before saving the form.

methods.name: set_pickup_company_address
methods.description: Fetches and sets the pickup company's address.

methods.name: set_delivery_company_address
methods.description: Fetches and sets the delivery company's address.

methods.name: pickup_from_type
methods.description: Handles changes when pickup source type is changed, resetting relevant fields.

methods.name: delivery_to_type
methods.description: Handles changes when delivery destination type is changed, resetting relevant fields.

methods.name: delivery_address_name
methods.description: Updates delivery address display based on address selection.

methods.name: pickup_address_name
methods.description: Updates pickup address display based on address selection.

methods.name: get_contact_display
methods.description: Fetches and displays contact details, ensuring email or phone is present.

methods.name: delivery_contact_name
methods.description: Triggers contact detail fetch for delivery contact.

methods.name: pickup_contact_name
methods.description: Triggers contact detail fetch for pickup contact.

methods.name: pickup_contact_person
methods.description: Fetches contact details for selected pickup contact person.

methods.name: set_company_contact
methods.description: Sets contact info based on current user for delivery or pickup.

methods.name: pickup_company
methods.description: Handles changes to pickup company, setting address and contact.

methods.name: delivery_company
methods.description: Handles changes to delivery company, setting address and contact.

methods.name: delivery_customer
methods.description: Sets delivery address and contact based on customer selection.

methods.name: delivery_supplier
methods.description: Sets delivery address and contact based on supplier selection.

methods.name: pickup_customer
methods.description: Sets pickup address and contact based on customer selection.

methods.name: pickup_supplier
methods.description: Sets pickup address and contact based on supplier selection.

methods.name: set_address_name
methods.description: Fetches and sets address name for a reference doctype and document.

methods.name: set_contact_name
methods.description: Fetches and sets contact name for a reference doctype and document.

methods.name: add_template
methods.description: Adds parcel details from a selected parcel template.

methods.name: pickup_date
methods.description: Validates that pickup date is not before today.

methods.name: clear_pickup_fields
methods.description: Clears pickup-related fields.

methods.name: clear_delivery_fields
methods.description: Clears delivery-related fields.

methods.name: remove_email_row
methods.description: Removes email entries from a specified table.
